claim_boundary: This is a one-new-seed development sufficiency test. It does not confirm a population-level v2, identify a biological gain-control mechanism, introduce a second memory channel, or permit tuning on the Liu graph. A failed gate-only pilot rejects this low-capacity sufficiency route, not the positive v1 mechanism backbone or the project-level scientific question.

task_distribution.held_out_graph_scope: source-correct Liu graph and its rank-axis reflection

crossing_alignment.orientation_reduction: mean conditioned gamma over the two direct orientations

registered_rules.fast_weight_necessity: The conditioned condition passes every qualification_v2 intervention and order-invariance rule.
registered_rules.global_reassembly_preservation: Conditioned remote absolute and third-party relational estimands each have bootstrap lower bounds above zero and point estimates at least 80 percent of original v1.
registered_rules.local_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for conditioned minus original retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero, and H>A under conditioned is not robustly wrong-sign (its bootstrap upper bound is at least zero).
registered_rules.nonlearned_preservation: Conditioned nonlearned accuracy is at least 0.70 and no more than 0.02 below original v1.
registered_rules.online_mechanism_alignment: The Spearman correlation between online gamma and offline crossing midpoint is positive; it is mechanistic support but cannot rescue a failed local, specificity, or global-preservation gate.
registered_rules.preserve_other_relations: The conditioned-minus-original mean over the other seven retained relations has a bootstrap lower bound no smaller than -0.01.
registered_rules.query_binding_preservation: Both conditioned matched-minus-mismatch normalized operator-gain contrasts remain positive. Because this estimand is pre-gate, exact equality to original within 1e-7 is required.
registered_rules.state_conditioning_specificity: Conditioned retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds both matched-global and shuffled controls at the point-estimate level; conditioned minus at least one of these controls must also have a paired-bootstrap lower bound above zero.
registered_rules.terminal_projection_preservation: The conditioned expected-rank-minus-MAP alignment participant-bootstrap lower bound exceeds zero.

lock.execution_rule: Use this lock for the complete seed-2101 evaluation retry. The original protocol, checkpoint, gate artifact, conditions, estimands, and thresholds remain immutable.
